snippet.title: New QBIX Game | SkiBiGo
snippet.description:
Ready, Set, SKIBIGOOOOO!
SkiBiGo is the latest wacky, high-energy QBIX game where up to 6 players race, jump, and dodge through 3 thrilling levels.  Welcome to the craziest race you’ve never trained for! 
With high-energy gameplay across three screens, a competitive leaderboard, and a fun social vibe, it's a wild ride to victory!
Learn more about QBIX: https://inowize.com/qbix/ 
 
QBIX is a 6-player, self-service immersive game room packed with 5D effects like wind blasts and a vibrating floor, all in a compact 13x13 ft space.
